// fix3-lights: light bands: separate smoked PC lens per band (real 0.4 mm gap replaces the groove), sealed lamp module behind it, bosses, harness, halo feed (lightkit.py)

lights.// lens: separate smoke PC lens (IR-transparent tint, hard-coat outside, dead-front IR-transparent black print inside except the light windows / pupil, silver ring print); gap = real joint to the body opening (was a 0.6 x 0.3 groove); roll_body / roll_lens = edge radii; t = lens thickness = wall
lights.// housing: black PC/ABS lamp housing, laser-welded to the lens back face (inner / outer wall faces weld_in / weld_out inside the outline (wall 1.5, the weld land between them) at u = weld_u); step_d / step_u = light trap step behind the gap and gasket face; d_out* = flange width beyond the outline (top / bottom / ends), d_trap over the charger slot (|y| < trap_y: no gasket, drain); gasket_in / gasket_edge = gasket band; u_back = back-plate depth by |y| (under the A-surface) per module; back_t; vent = [y, z, r] ePTFE vent
lights.// bar: PMMA light bar behind each light window: y0..y1, z0..z1 about the band axis, u0..u1 depth; 45 deg TIR periscope leg at leg_y..y1 down to leg_u; carrier_t = white PC carrier channel wall
lights.// board: LED end board (FR4) y0..y1, +-z_half, front face at u0, thickness t; led = [w, h, t] of the 3030 LED
lights.// pupil: front centre: board [half width, half height, front-face u], cam = [holder size, depth, barrel r, barrel front u], tof = [w, h, t], tof_y, led_y, pipe_r
lights.// dot: rear centre: board [half w, half h, front-face u], pipe_r, led
lights.// bosses: screw bosses on the body wall [|y|, dz] (dz 0: on the band axis at the lens end, else under the lens), od / hole (PT K25), seat_u = ear seat depth, ear_t / ear_w, gusset_t, sink = base fused into the wall, screw = [d, length, head d, head h]; fit_hole / slot = the locating holes of the two end ears (left round, right slot along y), clear_hole = lower ears
lights.// connector: sealed module connector on the back plate: y, dz, w, h, wall, shroud len, plug_len (right-angle plug, cable exits upward)
lights.// harness: cable_d per module; per module: path waypoints (world m) from the plug exit, grommet [x, y, z deck top, hole r, deck t], clips [x, y, z, foot direction, foot h], service [x, y, z, axis, cradle offsets 2x, deck z], chassis_lead waypoints; grommet_holes [x, y, rx, ry] are cut into the deck by design_gen
lights.// halo: status halo feed: clear boss r on the lid underside at the halo ring's front point, gap_closed to the emitter LED (lid closed), emitter = [x, y, t] LED board on the control panel's front strip, led_h; panel_z = panel top there
